data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word yoledet meaning 'daughter of Jehovah'. Yolene is a beautiful name with a rich Biblical heritage. The name Yolene carries the meaning “Jewel or Beauty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Yolene usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel or beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: יולין
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים יולד ישוע המשיח הוא האור שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יולין הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים יולד ישוע המשיח הוא האור שלי'. השם קשור לנושא האור והישועה בישוע המשיח, והוא משמש כזכר לאור האלוהי שמאיר על עמו.

in_greek.name: Γιολένη
in_greek.long_meaning: Γιολένη είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός γεννάει φως'. Το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με το θέμα του φωτός και της σωτηρίας στον Ιησού Χριστό και χρησιμεύει ως ανάμνηση του θείου φωτός που φωτίζει τον λαό του.

in_latin.name: Yolene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Yolene originem trahit ex lingua Graeca et significat 'Deus generat lux mea'. Nomen hoc coniungitur cum themate lucis et salvationis in Iesu Christo et servit ad memoriam divini luminis quod illuminat populum suum.

in_english.name: Yolene
in_english.meaning: God brings light, derived from Greek
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yolene originates from Greek roots, signifying 'God brings light' or 'God is my light'. It symbolizes the divine light of God shining upon His people. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of God as the light of His people is prevalent throughout scripture. Historically, the name Yolene has been used in Christian traditions to signify the illumination and guidance that comes from God. The personality traits associated with this name include spiritual guidance, illumination, and divine protection. Today, Yolene remains a meaningful name across various Christian cultures.
